Though this matter has come up for admission,
with consent of learned counsel for parties, it is taken up for hearing.

2. This appeal is filed against the judgment and award dated 17.10.2022 passed by the Member,
Motor Accident Claims Tribunal- II, Yadagiri, in MVC No.176 of 2021.

sentences.text: 3. The injured claimant, aged 23 years, working as a Supervisor in sugar factory, met with an accident on 14.02.2021, and filed a claim application claiming NC: 2025:KHC-K:7443 HC-KAR compensation of Rs.30,00,000/- with interest.
The Tribunal, considering the entire evidence on record, granted the compensation of Rs.8,00,030/- with interest at the rate of 6 percent per annum from the date of petition till realisation.
4. Aggrieved by the said order, this appeal is preferred by the appellant-claimant in which it is mainly contended that he sustained grievous injuries and was in the hospital for 35 days.
The Tribunal granted inadequate compensation.
The amount granted under other heads is meager.
Though doctor assessed the disability as 78% and the Tribunal has taken 20% disability.
He sustained 100% disability as there is shortening of right lower limb by 2 inches.
Thus, requested for enhancement.
5. Heard the arguments of both sides.

sentences.text: 6. Learned counsel for respondent insurance company contended that as per wound certificate issued under Exhibit P6, the claimant sustained the fracture to right leg and he was referred to the higher centre for confirmation of the fracture.
Thereafter, they have taken X-ray and it was found that the NC: 2025:KHC-K:7443 HC-KAR fracture was united.

The petitioner examined P.W.2-doctor, who issued disability certificate under Exhibit P13, wherein the doctor observed as follows:
"Surgical seal mark on right knee joint, multiple discharging sinus present around knee and main loss of ROM of right knee is 100%.
Shortening of right LL by 2 centimeters compared to left leg."
7. The doctor assessed the disability as 78% to the lower limb.
The doctor further stated that the claimant requires another surgery for removal of the implants and the estimated cost is Rs.40,000/-.
8. Learned counsel for the appellant contended that the claimant sustained simple injuries as per the wound certificate.

Though in the wound certificate, it was mentioned that he sustained fracture and the fracture was shown only as a simple injury, but it cannot be treated as a simple injury, and it amounts to grievous injury.
9. Admittedly, the petitioner sustained shortening of the leg.
Therefore, this Court finds it reasonable to take one third of 78% disability as 26% instead of 20% taken by the Tribunal.
NC: 2025:KHC-K:7443 HC-KAR
The Tribunal has taken income as only Rs.15,000/-.
Though petitioner-claimant has stated that he was earning Rs.15,000/- per month, he has not filed any proof of income.
He met with the accident on 14.02.2021 and as per the guidelines of the Karnataka State Legal Services Authority, his notional income is to be taken as Rs.14,250/- per month.
The claimant was aged 23 years and the multiplier is 18.
So, the loss of future earning capacity comes to Rs.8,00,280/- (14,250 x12 x18 x 26%)

The medical expenses granted by the Tribunal at Rs.12,030/-
needs no interference.
The petitioner was hospitalized for a period of 35 days.

Therefore, this Court finds it reasonable to grant an amount of Rs.60,000/- for pain and suffering, Rs.30,000/- for loss of amenities and Rs.40,000/-for transportation, extra nourishment and attendant charges.
The petitioner might not have worked any other work at least for a period of four months.

Therefore,
Rs.57,000/- (14,250 x 4) is granted under the head loss of income during laid-up period.
The petitioner is also entitled for Rs.40,000/- towards future medical expenses for removal of the implants.
Thus, in all, the claimant is entitled for the compensation of Rs.10,39,310/- with interest at 6% per annum as against Rs.8,00,030/- awarded by the Tribunal.
NC: 2025:KHC-K:7443 HC-KAR 10.

The award of compensation passed by the Tribunal is modified as under:

(iv) On such deposit, the claimant is permitted to withdraw the entire amount along with the interest accrued on it.
